newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers firmer but buying interest thin.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers firmer but buying interest thin.

text.p: Singapore bunker suppliers lifted their offers higher on Wednesday, believing prices should advance further in line with recent firm cargo prices and crude values, traders said.
However, shipowners were staying away and unwilling to fan the the uptrend. "Demand is not that great but bunker prices just move along with strong cargo and crude," said one trader.
Bunker 180-cst was quoted at $104-108 per tonne and 380-cst was at $98-102, about $3 more than Tuesday's levels. MDO and gas oil were at $198-$203 and $210-$217 respectively.
